## Modules

The package `src/omeka2dsp/` has twelve modules.
The pure modules do all data work. They do not read files or use the network.
The IO modules read settings, call the Omeka and DSP APIs, and write the log.

| Module         | Kind | Content                                                               |
| -------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `settings.py`  | IO   | `Settings`. Reads `.env` and the environment.                         |
| `omeka.py`     | IO   | Read items and media from the Omeka API or from a snapshot directory. |
| `dsp.py`       | IO   | `Dsp` client: login, search, read, create, change, erase, ingest.     |
| `fields.py`    | pure | `FIELDS` table, the `Field` model, and the `Project` model.           |
| `values.py`    | pure | Omeka records and values to DSP values. DSP values to comparison keys. |
| `lists.py`     | pure | List label to list node IRI.                                          |
| `media.py`     | pure | Media class, privacy, placeholder, ingest file name.                  |
| `plan.py`      | pure | `Change` model. Compare current and wanted values. Return changes.    |
| `payload.py`   | pure | JSON-LD bodies for create, change, erase, and file permissions.       |
| `preflight.py` | pure | Check a payload against the ontology.                                 |
| `sync.py`      | IO   | Connect the parts: one item, then its media.                          |
| `cli.py`       | IO   | Typer app with the `sync` and `add-text-class` commands.              |

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  cli --> sync
  cli --> settings
  sync --> omeka
  sync --> dsp
  sync --> plan
  sync --> payload
  sync --> preflight
  sync --> media
  plan --> values
  payload --> values
  payload --> plan
  values --> lists
  values --> fields
  plan --> fields
  payload --> fields
  preflight --> fields
  media --> values
  classDef io fill:#ffe880
  class cli,sync,omeka,dsp,settings io
```

The yellow modules do IO. All other modules are pure.

These rules apply to all modules:

- Data that crosses a boundary has a type. Pydantic models parse Omeka records and settings.
- All models are frozen. A function returns a new value and does not change its input.
- No module reads the environment at import time. `Settings` loads once and goes down as an argument.
- All requests use one `requests.Session` and the timeout `HTTP_TIMEOUT`.

## Sync flow

`sync` does these steps for each selected item:

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  item[Omeka item] --> find{Parent on DSP?}
  find -- yes --> diff[Plan changes and apply them]
  find -- no --> pre1{Preflight OK?}
  pre1 -- no --> skip[Skip item and its media]
  pre1 -- yes --> create[Create Parent]
  diff --> media
  create --> media[For each media]
  media --> found{Media on DSP?}
  found -- "same class" --> mdiff[Plan changes, apply them, restrict private files]
  found -- "other class, no --recreate" --> mdiff
  found -- "no, or other class with --recreate" --> pre2{Preflight OK?}
  pre2 -- no --> keep[Keep DSP as is]
  pre2 -- yes --> ingest{File needed?}
  ingest -- yes --> up{Ingest OK?}
  up -- no --> keep
  up -- yes --> erase
  ingest -- no --> erase[Erase old record, if any]
  erase --> mcreate[Create media]
```

A dry run follows the same path. It logs each write and does not send it.
DSP cannot change the class of a resource. Thus a media in the wrong class gets new values only, until you give `--recreate`.

## Safety rules

Each failure stops the run or skips one record. A failure never deletes data.
Each rule has a test in `test/`.

1. An unresolved list label keeps the DSP value.
2. An unresolved type label blocks all type deletions.
3. A recreate erases the old record only after preflight and ingest succeed.
4. An item without a Parent on DSP has its media skipped.
5. A failed list request stops the run.
6. Missing credentials stop the run before network access.
7. Private and placeholder media get metadata only. Their files are restricted.
8. A file that is the placeholder image is not ingested.

A failed Omeka page, a failed DSP read, and a failed DSP search also stop the run.
A failed write logs an error and the run continues with the next value or record.

## Tests

The golden tests in `test/test_golden.py` hold the request bodies for the records in `data/example_omeka_*`.
A change to a golden file in `test/golden/` is a change to the behaviour.
To write the golden files again, run `GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 uv run --extra dev pytest test/test_golden.py`.
